great-crucible.png.name: Great crucible
great-crucible.png.description: The mega forge's head: a colossal tilting crucible on its working platform, its control core housed on its west flank and its spout pouring east onto the line.

great-crucible-melt.png.name: Great crucible melt
great-crucible-melt.png.description: Overlay: the great crucible's melt and its spout's run, drawn over its body so the engine can pulse it.

furnace-core.png.name: Furnace control core
furnace-core.png.description: The great crucible's control core, cut free and lying on its transport skid: the prize.

tapping-furnace.png.name: Tapping furnace
tapping-furnace.png.description: The pour line's tapping furnace: a domed refractory roof ringed by charging ports, its taphole and spout trough running south toward the crane bay.

tapping-furnace-melt.png.name: Tapping furnace melt
tapping-furnace-melt.png.description: Overlay: the melt in the tapping furnace's taphole and spout trough, so the engine can pulse it.

ladle-hook.png.name: Ladle on its hook
ladle-hook.png.description: A pouring ladle hanging from the overhead crane hook, full of melt. Overhead: drawn above units.

ladle-hook-tipped.png.name: Ladle tipped mid-pour
ladle-hook-tipped.png.description: The same ladle on its hook, tipped mid-pour, its bowl near empty. Overhead: drawn above units.

ladle-hook-tipped-pour.png.name: Ladle pour
ladle-hook-tipped-pour.png.description: Overlay: the melt pouring from the tipped ladle's lip.

ore-car.png.name: Ore charge car
ore-car.png.description: An armoured ore charge car on its rail wheels, its hopper heaped with ore and scrap.

ore-car-derailed.png.name: Derailed ore car
ore-car-derailed.png.description: The ore charge car jumped off its rail and slewed askew, a little of its load spilled.

cooling-rack.png.name: Cooling rack
cooling-rack.png.description: An empty steel cooling rack: an open frame of rails and crossbars.

cooling-rack-castings.png.name: Cooling rack with castings
cooling-rack-castings.png.description: The cooling rack with castings left on four of its shelves when the work stopped.

fettling-bench.png.name: Fettling bench
fettling-bench.png.description: A heavy fettling bench with its grinding wheel, vice and tools.

inspection-table.png.name: Inspection table
inspection-table.png.description: A steel inspection table with its gauge plate and scanner head.

pour-head.png.name: Pour head
pour-head.png.description: The line's pour head module: an armoured nozzle unit on four clamps. A b3 haul.

mould-master.png.name: Mould master
mould-master.png.description: The line's mould master module: a precision block with four master pattern faces. A b3 haul.

fallen-girder.png.name: Fallen crane girder
fallen-girder.png.description: An overhead crane girder fallen across the bay floor under its runway: the hall's best cover.

rail-bed.png.name: Rail bed
rail-bed.png.description: A length of rail track sunk flush in floor plate: the ore spur and the slag car track. A run: lay copies end to end north-south (rotate for east-west); it repeats seamlessly.

rail-bed-curve.png.name: Rail bed curve
rail-bed-curve.png.description: The rail bed turning a quarter circle, meeting a straight bed at its south and east edges.

rail-buffer.png.name: Rail buffer stop
rail-buffer.png.description: The end of a rail bed: a buffer stop beam at its north end, the track running out of its south edge.

slag-car.png.name: Slag car
slag-car.png.description: A slag pot car on its rail wheels, cooled slag crusted in its pot.

slag-car-melt.png.name: Slag car glow
slag-car-melt.png.description: Overlay: the glowing crack in the slag car's crust.

slag-car-tipped.png.name: Slag car tipped
slag-car-tipped.png.description: The slag car tipped over at the slag pit's lip, its pot rolled east. Lay it with its east edge on the pit's edge.

slag-car-tipped-spill.png.name: Slag car spill
slag-car-tipped-spill.png.description: Overlay: the slag running out of the tipped pot to its east edge, into the pit.

pallet-bay.png.name: Pallet bay marking
pallet-bay.png.description: Worn bay markings for dispatch: four corner brackets and a bay label bar, the rest transparent. Lay side by side for a row of bays.

trench-cover.png.name: Trench cover
trench-cover.png.description: Chequer-plate covers over a service trench between steel kerbs. A run north-south; repeats seamlessly.

drain-gutter.png.name: Drain gutter
drain-gutter.png.description: A slotted drain channel in floor plate. A run north-south; repeats seamlessly.

floor-drain.png.name: Floor drain
floor-drain.png.description: A square floor drain grate in its frame.

crane-runway.png.name: Crane runway
crane-runway.png.description: Overhead: a crane runway girder with its rail, a column cap at its middle. Drawn above units. A run north-south; repeats seamlessly every 4 cells.

cable-tray.png.name: Cable tray
cable-tray.png.description: Overhead: a ladder cable tray with its cables. Drawn above units. A run north-south; repeats seamlessly.

cable-tray-fallen.png.name: Fallen cable tray
cable-tray-fallen.png.description: A cable tray fallen to the floor, bent, its cables spilled.
